products.title: Fundamentals of Brazilian Jiu Jitsu Escapes Gi & No Gi by Lachlan Giles
products.body:
Learn how to escape from Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu’s worst positions with Lachlan Giles’s new 8-volume series on escaping

  • Watch Lachlan spar from bad positions with narration so you can see the techniques at work
  • This series covers both gi and no-gi solutions and concepts for getting out of mount, back, side control, and more
  • Understand each position’s threats, how to stay safe, and your path back to safety better than ever before.



Get Out Of Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu’s Worst Positions, Gi Or No-Gi, With Lachlan Giles’s Insights Into Escaping

The 2019 ADCC Absolute Medalist Teaches How To Get Out Bad Grappling Positions With Narrated Live Rolling Of Him Performing The Techniques

What Will You Learn?

Learn how to escape from Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu’s worst positions and survive underneath with Lachlan Giles’s new 8-volume series on escaping gi or no-gi. Lachlan shows how he gets away from all major controls, including the mount, side control, the back, and more, both with and without a gi on. Watch as Lachlan breaks down every position to the major concepts, movements, escapes, and more, and tying his techniques together with narrated footage of him sparring from these same positions.

Lachlan Giles shows his full system for escaping trouble, so you can stay in the fight once your guard is passed and danger is near. With half in the gi, and half out, you can get reliable answers for both styles that can build off each other. In no time, you will be escaping fluidly from tight top control and submission threats with these pathways to freedom.

Understand the dangers and weaknesses of each of the major positions you’ll get stuck in, as Lachlan explains how to stay safe and work your way out with technique. Get out of tight side controls, mount, back control, front headlocks, and more as he takes each one and explores every detail you’ll need. In every position, Lachlan goes through all the variations as well, explaining how they’ll change your answers and how to stay cool under pressure so you can think easier.

Combine all of the most important fundamental movements of escaping together to create a potent escape style, with these helpful insights from ADCC Absolute medalist Lachlan Giles. Lachlan’s thorough and step-by-step instructions help students of any level understand and benefit from his knowledge, and with these details in your game you can stop fearing the guard pass so much and start attacking with style.

It’s inevitable that if you do Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, especially early on, you will get your guard passed a lot, and escaping from bad positions is one of the most important jobs of a BJJ student. Now, arm yourself with the knowledge you need to make these escapes like clockwork, with Lachlan’s 8-volume series. Learn the techniques, learn the system, then watch the system in action as he goes live from all the same positions to show his method at work.

So, What Exactly Do You Get?

products.title: The Guard Retention Anthology: Through The Legs and Close Range by Lachlan Giles & Ariel Tabak
products.body:
Lachlan Giles and Ariel Tabak show you a total technical gameplan for keeping your guard against any attack through the middle or smashing in close range (including half guard)

  • Defend knee cuts, half guard passes, smash passes, headquarters position, and more with tips on how to keep the guard, improve position, and get back on the attack.
  • ADCC Absolute medalist Lachlan Giles teams up with his guard retention specialist and black belt Ariel Tabak for this 8-part instructional release.
  • Study your guard retention across the two volumes, Through The Legs & Close Range and the sister series, Around & Under The Legs
  • See every technique applied live with rolling footage from Ariel and Lachlan applying these concepts against grapplers in the gym.
  • This is one of the most detailed and complete guard retention instructionals ever made, with precise technical breakdowns of the moves and strategies that will let you retain your guard.


Keep Your Guard Against Some of BJJ’s Most Common Passes (Including Half Guard Details You Must Know) Using This Guard Retention Masterclass From The Smallest ADCC Open Weight Medalist In History: Lachlan Giles and Black Belt Specialist Ariel Tabak



Check Out The Trailer!

Learn the best guard retention possible with techniques, strategies, and more from ADCC Absolute medalist Lachlan Giles and black belt guard retention specialist Ariel Tabak. This series, one of two major volumes from Lachlan & Ariel, covers all of the passes and attacks that come through the middle and in close ranges, and how to stop them, counter them, and keep your guard in tact.

Lachlan and Ariel show a total step-by-step breakdown of how to retain your guard and all of the techniques and movements you need, on this 8-part series for close range and through the legs passes. With general concepts, specific techniques, and ways to get back on offense, this series can help you find all the most important and useful details for success.


Lachlan Giles and Ariel Tabak train together in Australia, at Absolute MMA, where they have developed a clear and effective guard retention style that lets them stay on offense, even against aggressive players. Now you can see this system, across two 8-part series, in action, as they teach and then share live rolling breakdowns of them using this to succeed in the gym.

The next time your opponent goes for a knee cut, an attack from half guard, a smash pass, or more, you can have the exact answer with this series’s total systemic approach. Across 8 volumes, find anything you need to combat those guard passes and get right back on offense!

products.title: No Gi Open Guard Volume 3: RDLR & Leg Entanglements by Lachlan Giles
products.body:
Combine your attacks into a no-gi open guard system that grapplers of all level can use to sweep, submit, and more off your back with Lachlan Giles!
  • Use the Reverse De La Riva guard to retain guard and start launching attacks off your back, with options to invert and not invert under for a more potent arsenal.
  • Enter into the legs with traditional single leg X and X guard options that help you leg lock and transition to stronger positions.
  • Lachlan Giles is an ADCC Absolute bronze medalist, with one of the most legendary runs to the podium ever using the techniques he uses on this series.
  • Learn the 70/30 heel hook position that Lachlan specializes in, including how to heel hook systematically.

ADCC Absolute Medalist Lachlan Giles Shares His System For The No-Gi Open Guard With Reverse De La Riva & Leg Entanglements On This 8-Volume Mega Series

 

Check out a free sample:

What Will You Learn?

Learn the systematic no-gi open guard with this 8-volume series on using the reverse de la riva guard and the X guard to set up leg entanglements, sweeps, and more with Lachlan Giles’s help. Lachlan is one of the most requested instructors on BJJ Fanatics, and now you can learn some of the same tricks that helped him excel in his career.

Lachlan Giles used his tricky and methodical open guard to medal in the absolute division in the 2019 ADCC World Championships, heel hooking three much larger black belts on his way to bronze. Now you can learn some of those same techniques in this masterclass on using the reverse De La Riva and the x guard family to attack.

With options to invert and options that don’t need inverting, learn how grapplers of all levels can use this series to level up. Use the reverse De La Riva hook to manage pressure, off balance, and find your way to high percentage offense using Lachlan’s guidance and structured teaching.

Modify the X guard and learn how to take this well known leg locking position and start using it for innovative and proven entries into 50/50 attacks and inside heel hooks from unusual angles, with Lachlan showing you every detail you’ll need for success.
